desktop.tagline: Attio deals, people and companies for your agent

signIn.gives: Lets your agent read your Attio deals, people and companies and call the Attio API.
signIn.asks: An access token: in Attio, Workspace settings → Developers → New access token, with read access to records, object configuration and user management. Only a workspace admin can make one.
